# CSV exporter

Run `python scripts/export.py <input.csv> <output.csv>` to normalise a CSV export: header first, then rows.

## Gotchas
- **A UTF-8 BOM in the input corrupts the first header** (2026-09-01): export.py opens the input with
  `encoding="utf-8-sig"`, which strips the BOM, so the first column reads `id`, not `\ufeffid`.
files.skills/csv-exporter/scripts/export.py:
import csv
import sys


def export(path, out):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        rows = csv.reader(fh)
        header = next(rows)
        body = list(rows)
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    export(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

def export(path, out):

files.skills/csv-exporter/scripts/export.py:
import csv
import sys


def export(path, out):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        rows = csv.reader(fh)
        header = next(rows)
        body = list(rows)
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    export(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
